title: Sajjad Ban Kay Qaidi
body:
Koyi Zulm Takiya Aysa, Ayenu Khoon Jis Rowaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maare Bhain Koyi Ainj Na, Majboor Hovay Bhayi
Rab Janay Kivay Abid , Ous Di Qabar Banaye
Do Qaidiyaan Nay Mill Kay, Mayaat Sakina Chaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Uth Shaam Challiye Abid, Meray Veer Maargaye Saaray
Nayzay Day Naal Burqay, Saday Shaamiyaan Utaray
Ay Keh Kay Ghaash Toh Zainab, Sajjad Nu Jagaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Lutt Karbala Di Wapis, Sajjad Nu Milli Ay
Zainab Bhira Di Ungli, Bao Dair Labdi Raye Ay
Khaali Angothi Tay Durr, Bas Bhain Day Oh Laya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aakhe Day Kaneez Qaidan Darbar Vich Kamina
Kulsoom Day Galay Laag, Rondi Rayhi Sakina
Raiya Mout Mangda Abid, Ainj Aookha Veela Aaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Milya Wafa Da Jaag Toon, Wakhra Tenu Inaam Ay
Rahay Parday Chaar Fizza, Teri Goud Vich Imam Ay
Tenu Bhain Sadya Zahra, Dhi Mustafa Banaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zalim Nu Aakh Abid, Menu Devay Sirr Bhira Da
Hun Taan Karaan Main Matam, Mazloom-e-karbala Da
Hovay Puri Dil Di Hasraat, Main Soug Naye Manaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tanveer Jud Ujaar Kay Zainab Wataan Tay Aayi
Taak Haal Bhain Da Naye Pehchaan Sakiya Bhayi
Moutan Day Ghum Tay Qaidaan, Zainab Nu Ainj Mukaya
